summary: A Part-II-style extension of PadicFamilies to coherent cohomology in every degree. Integral supported Hida theory is proved for Siegel varieties of arbitrary genus, while higher Coleman theory and its eigenvarieties use the general abelian-type, locally quasi-split datum supported by Boxer–Pilloni. Derived specialization, singular weights, boundary conditions and normalization are explicit. General integral Hodge/PEL Hida theory and sharper bounds on full general Coleman cohomology remain recorded gaps.

nodes.title: Dynamical compactifications
nodes.statement: A dynamical compactification consists of proper Xbar,Cbar over S, two maps p1,p2, closed subschemes D+,D− with X=Xbar\(D+∪D−) and C=Cbar\(p1*D+∪p2*D−), and p2*D+⊂p1*D+, p1*D−⊂p2*D− on underlying sets. Compact dynamics replaces these by inclusions in the interiors of the right-hand closed subsets in the solid/discrete-adic locale. D+ and D− may intersect. Transposition swaps p1,p2 and D+,D−.

nodes.title: Sharp Siegel bounds and classicality

For coefficient comparison the larger proved BGG exclusion is λ not≥−ν_v for every v≠1 in + and its transposed dual in −; combine it with geometric smallness to obtain classical eigenvariety points. This is a theorem in every genus, with integral lattices supplied by B7; no general noncompact abelian-type analogue is asserted.

nodes.statement: In derived C2 coordinates choose G-dominance 0≥ν1≥ν2, M-dominance κ1≥κ2, ρ=(−1,−2) and 2ρ_nc=(−3,−3). nodes.statement: For GL2, d=1 and W_M={1}; the geometric finite-slope Cousin sequence reads 0→H^0_class(ω^k)→H^0_id,oc(ω^k)→H^1_long,oc(ω^k)→H^1_class(ω^k)→0. For k≥2 the standard degree-zero q-expansion operator U_std=p⁻¹U_naive has classicality slope <k−1. For k≤0 the integral degree-one operator has threshold <1−k. At k=1 neither argument gives an automatic strict-positive window. Ordinary degree-zero families are imported from PadicFamilies; the complementary projective degree-one family specializes for k≥3 to ordinary H^1(ω^(2−k)(−D)) and pairs perfectly with the degree-zero family.

nodes.title: Singular Klingen interpolation complex
nodes.statement: For the Siegel threefold at Klingen level let X_Kli^≥1 be the formal locus where its distinguished height-one subgroup is multiplicative. Over its height-one tower X_∞, let IG_∞=Isom(µ_(p∞),H_∞), a Z_p× torsor. The tower maps are affine étale, not finite; on p-rank one they are isomorphisms. With Λ1=Z_p[[Z_p×]] form F_κ by descent of O_(IG∞) completed-tensor Λ1 with the diagonal universal character, first colim over Igusa level modulo p^n and then lim_n. It is invertible over the completed scalar extension on X_∞, not asserted finite locally free over the original X_Kli^≥1. Define M_Kli=f RΓ(X_Kli^≥1,F_κ⊗det(ω)^2(−D)), where f is the ordinary projector for Pilloni U=U1U2. On Ω(k,r)=Sym^kω⊗det(ω)^r, this U has raw pullback/trace normalization p^(−3−r) for the correspondence of isogeny type (1,p,p,p²).

Descend the universal one-dimensional character and use the prescribed completed level limits.

nodes.statement: For unitary signature (n,1), n≥1, at a split good prime with neat tame level and the Coleman datum, use derived A_n coordinates and M=GL_n×GL_1, d=n.
